scale_zero_helper.main_info_behavior: Wrapper zero-initializes result fields, invokes native MIG, then copies results even on query error. A failed lookup can therefore overwrite the caller scale default1 with0; root namespace failure alone does not establish the values returned to mobile SpringBoard.

bks_scale_selection.logic: Helper compares the input display pointer with [CADisplay displays].firstObject. Identical main object uses native BKS main-screen-info scale. Other objects, including a distinct immutable copy, use display.pointScale; if tag&0xe0 it uses currentMode.preferredScale instead.
